svg.text: DETAIL C: RECLINE MECHANISM (SECTION ON THE LOCK), 1:2
DETAIL E: LAP BELT BUCKLE, PLAN, 1:1
TRACK STUD (7) LOCKS IN THE SEAT TRACK
1. Recline: press the button (22) and the hydraulic lock (19) opens;
lean back up to 5°. Let go and the back is held. Sit up and the
back follows. Large button, light force: usable by all passengers.
2. Armrests (23) lift 90° on their pivot pins for access from the aisle.
3. Lap belt: lift lever buckle, opened with one movement of either hand,
by the passenger or the crew. Length 1170 to 1420 by the slide bar.
4. Leg FEA, 9 g forward: peak 227 MPa at the brace to boss corner,
safety factor 2.2 on 7075-T6. Strut stresses agree with the hand
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
